title: Biiig Hug
description: Upon pickup, remove 4 cards from your Deck. Whenever you shuffle your Draw Pile, add a Soot into your Draw Pile.
flavor: Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...
notes: This relic removes 4 cards from your deck via interactive selection when obtained. Each time you shuffle your Draw Pile, a Soot card is added to it at a random position. Hover tips display details about the Soot card generated.
